title: Cuban Sandwich
description: Cuban Sandwich is a dish from Cuba featuring pork loin, orange juice, garlic, baguette. This home-sized recipe records each ingredient at the step where it is used.

steps.instruction: Combine the seasoning ingredients and coat the main protein or vegetables. Rest covered in the refrigerator for about 45 minutes.
Roast the already seasoned food in a preheated oven until tender and safely cooked, using a thermometer for meat or poultry.
Arrange the fully cooked and prepared parts of the dish on plates or in the intended serving vessel, adding the listed toppings or accompaniments just before serving.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 10 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
